title: Make model and effort explicit per role; let hard jobs upgrade planning
summary: Add per-role model and effort settings to athena.toml/config, pass both to the claude driver and record them on every invocation record, let the reading mark a job hard (with reason) to select a stronger planner model/effort, and show first-round accept rate, landed share and cost per landed job by model and effort in athena status. Audience: the Athena owner tuning planning quality.

defaults_applied.how: Tests for driver, upgrade, and status.
Empty buckets in status are not shown as success.
Decision doc and changelog written for outsiders.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Effort values are the Claude CLI's effort levels (e.g. low/medium/high); the driver passes them via the CLI's effort flag supported by the pinned version.
The reading gains an optional 'hard' flag with a reason; the harness maps it to a configured stronger planner setting, not free-form model choice.
Measures are computed from existing records; old records without effort are grouped under 'default/unrecorded'.
Planner means the producer role; critic means the verifier.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test (cargo test) shows the model and effort configured for a role reach the claude driver's invocation (as CLI arguments) and appear on the invocation record.

A test (cargo test) shows a reading marking a job hard gets the stronger planner model/effort with its reason recorded, while an ordinary reading keeps the configured default and records no upgrade reason.

A test (cargo test) shows athena status output lists first-round accept rate, landed share and cost per landed job per model and effort, including a bucket with no landed jobs without dividing by zero or showing a false success.

athena.toml names model and effort for each role (reader, planner/producer, verifier/critic) plus the stronger hard-job setting, and config.rs parses and validates them (rejecting unknown effort values); older records without effort still load.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry, docs/decisions.md records the decision with alternatives, and the entry notes request 20261013-042934-a1j8 is absorbed.
cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check pass.

out_of_scope: Changing the verifier model choice itself
Retroactively backfilling effort on old records
departures: Touches six crates' files across config, records, driver, run and status, so cost and time sit above the reference.
